title: Code-reviewer verdict
description: Reviewer's structured ACCEPT / FAIL verdict on a Coder patch.  v0.4 replaces the v0.3 markdown `ACCEPT` line / `FAIL: ...` feedback with this JSON shape.  Runtime's `is_accept_verdict_local` reads `verdict == "ACCEPT"` directly (no string-prefix heuristic needed).

verdict.description: ACCEPT → reflector loop terminates with this patch as the final reply.  FAIL → runtime feeds `issues` + `rationale` back to the Coder as revision instructions.

rationale.description: One-line summary.  For ACCEPT: what made the patch good (`byte-stable; canonical RawBlock shape`).  For FAIL: one-sentence summary of what's broken (`parser-converter uses hcl::* types that don't exist`).

location.description: Where in the patch the issue lives (`parser-converter section`, `tests/dataset_block_parses`, `ast.rs Project field`).

category.description: Closed enum of REJECT categories from `code_reviewer/knowledge/01_review_checklist.md`.

fix.description: Concrete actionable fix the Coder can apply.  Declarative (`Use RawBlock`), not interrogative (`Did you consider RawBlock?`).

issues.description: Required + non-empty when verdict == FAIL.  MUST be absent or empty array when verdict == ACCEPT.
